citations.claim: Reporting requires Pro, Business, or Enterprise, Viewers cannot open Reporting, and after a Starter to Pro upgrade existing users keep the Viewer role until an Admin changes them to Analyst in Settings → Users & Roles; signing out does not fix a missing permission.
Upgrading a plan does not change existing users' roles, so non-admin users remain Viewers and cannot open Reporting until an Admin changes their role to Analyst.

risk_flags: Two affected employees are not identified in the request
observed.draft_reply:
Hello Maya,

Thanks for reaching out about Reporting after your upgrade to Pro. Your account is on the Pro plan, which includes Reporting, so the cause is most likely user roles. Users who were already on your account keep the Viewer role after a Starter to Pro upgrade, and Viewers cannot open Reporting. Signing out or clearing the cache does not change a role.

To fix this, an Admin on your account (you or Aisha Rahman) can go to Settings, then Users & Roles, and change the affected users' role to Analyst.

Could you tell us the names or email addresses of the two employees who still cannot access Reporting? We will confirm their current role and walk you through the change.

Best regards,
Northstar Support
